text:
Customer: hi, I had an MRI on the 3rd and the hospital says insurance hasn't paid yet, can you check?
Agent: Sure, I can see the claim was received and is in review.
Customer: ok how long will that take
Agent: Usually 10 to 14 days. You'll get an EOB once it's processed.
Customer: fine, thanks

Customer: my doctor wants to do knee surgery and their office said they need approval from you first
Agent: That needs a pre-authorization from the provider's side.
Customer: they already sent it last week and nobody called back, this is ridiculous
Agent: I understand, let me connect you to the utilization review team.
Customer: please do

Customer: I lost my wallet and need a new insurance card
Agent: I can mail a replacement card, and you can also download a digital one from the app.
Customer: great, the app one works for now
Agent: Done, the new card ships in 5 days.

Customer: I got charged twice for the same lab test, my member number is MBR-88213077
Agent: I see two line items for that date.
Customer: I want this fixed today, I've called three times already
Agent: I'm sorry, I'll transfer you to a billing specialist who can reverse it.
Customer: fine

Customer: is there a dermatologist near Andheri that takes my plan?
Agent: Yes, I found three in-network dermatologists within 5 km.
Customer: can you text me the list on 9876543210
Agent: Sent. Anything else?
Customer: no that's all, thank you so much

Customer: my blood pressure tablets are running out, can I get a 90 day refill by mail
Agent: Yes, mail order covers a 90 day supply for your plan.
Customer: perfect, please set it up
Agent: It's placed, delivery in 3 to 5 days.

Customer: why was my claim for the ER visit denied?? I was in an accident
Agent: The claim shows it was denied for missing information from the hospital.
Customer: that's not my fault, this is so frustrating, I want to speak to someone who can actually fix it
Agent: I'll transfer you to the appeals team.

Customer: there's a 500 rupee charge on my statement I don't recognise
Agent: That's your copay for the specialist visit on the 12th.
Customer: oh right, I forgot about that one, makes sense
Agent: No problem.

Customer: does an MRI of the spine need pre approval on my plan
Agent: Yes it does, but your doctor's office submits it. Once approved you'll get a letter.
Customer: ok I'll tell them, thanks for explaining

Customer: the pharmacy says my insulin isn't covered anymore, I can't go without it
Agent: It looks like your plan's formulary changed this month.
Customer: I'm really worried, what am I supposed to do
Agent: Let me transfer you to a pharmacist who can check covered alternatives or an exception request.
